Code & scenery deep-dive

js/circuits/scenery/vegas.js is 877 lines, a single scenery(api) closure. Frame discipline is the main risk: file s=0 is the scenery origin (shift 0.8433); hero landmarks use sl() (racing frame) but the opening blocks use bare authored K(s).

Audit (audit-circuit vegas --json, 25.8 s): ok. verify OK; float 0 (cap 0); clip 0 severe; coplanar 12 (baseline 12 — at cap); props 343 198 tris identical; ground buried 0 / unsupported 0 / flatCoplanar 0. verify-track: 292 639 total verts, guard drops palm=6. graph-parity: not run (no tree diff; it needs BASE=<ref>).

Brief vs implementation: brief puts Sphere LEFT at s≈0.30; code puts it RIGHT at racing 0.28 / 125 m (comment cites Wikipedia loop). Brief's 'elevation dips 0.30-0.40' has no code basis. Brief asks for thin verge neon; line 613 builds a 2 m bar. Real-world: 6.201 km, 17 corners, 50 laps, 1.9 km Strip straight (Wikipedia, fetched 2026-10-15); built values agree on length (−0.5 %), corner count and straight.

Ranked defects

#SevDefect · cause · suggested fix (not applied)
1HighBellagio apron is a 2 m-tall, 95 m-long solid gold bar beside the kerb
js/circuits/scenery/vegas.js:613 — place(K(sl(0.68)),1,9,[10,2.0,95],gold). place() builds a collidable box (h=2.0), not a decal; at dist 9 it dominates lap frac 0.67 frames (day and night). Brief wants a thin emissive verge strip. Fix: groundPatch (as line 635) or h ≤ 0.2.
Frames vegas-05-orbit-*
2HighSphere reads as a stacked-bucket / bowl, not an orb; also ~57 % oversize
js/circuits/scenery/vegas.js:469-502 — rad=88 (176 m diameter AND height) built from 5 frustum bands + cylinders + 4 box meridians. Real venue is about 112 m tall × 157 m wide (public figures, not fetched this session — verify). Visible flat cut tops/equator slab in 03 and 08. Fix: more bands (≥10) with cos-spaced radii, rad ≈ 56-78, smooth cap.
vegas-03-orbit-*, vegas-08-trackside-*
3MedOvercast and fog do not change the sky; overcast ≈ dry
Lighting/weather response (js/lighting/atmosphere.js, merged PR #1979 tree): sky stays deep blue under overcast and fog; only terrain fog/exposure differ. Measured by eye on 6 frames each, no lightState read — hypothesis, not confirmed in code.
day-overcast, day-fog sets
4MedRoad sits on a visible raised berm with a dark steep skirt; storm/wet show a white ribbon on the road edge and black terrain underside
Terrain falls away from road edge (terrainOuter 26, js/circuits/vegas.js:24; terrain mesh 21.6k verts vs road 33.3k). Day frames 03/04 show 1-2 m drop; in storm/rain the skirt is black and edge is glaring white. Mechanism not isolated (wet specular on kerb/edge line vs terrain-under-road). Needs a lat-0 probe before fixing — AGENTS.md says probe flags are not findings until confirmed.
day-dry/storm/wet 03, 04
5MedNight race is under-lit: terrain, Sphere and Strip canyon barely glow
Palette pal.sunColor/ambient (vegas.js:43) are day-ish purples; night frames show only window rectangles and lamp pools. The 'built from light' brief (docs/tracks/vegas.md §2) is not met: Sphere wash, lake glow and storefront pods contribute no visible light/bloom. Lighting-tuner territory, not scenery.
night-dry/rain 03,05
6LowPit-straight lamps use bare authored K(s): they land on the Harmon approach

Same frame mix in guardrail(0.16-0.21)/(0.45-0.49) at :178-179 whose comments say T3 / T8-T9 but land at racing ~0.00-0.05 / 0.29-0.33, and stripNeon(0.01-0.08) at :311. Gallery — weather × time of day × lap position

Orbit cam (dist 75, el 20, az 40 — the engine nudges it clear of obstacles), TLX backend, SwiftShader. Full-size JPEGs (≤900 px) are under artifacts/shots/tracks/vegas/ with names vegas-NN-view-tod-weather.jpg.

Night · dry (the race condition)

Reference look. Window grids and neon hoardings carry the scene; terrain and the Sphere are almost unlit.

Night · rain

Terrain goes pitch black; wet surfaces add little reflected neon. Cars with lights visible on the grid (01).

Day · dry

Deep-blue sky, saturated sand terrain. Shows geometry honestly: the road sits on a berm, the Bellagio apron is a 2 m gold bar, the lake is an opaque slab.

Day · wet

Day · rain

Post PR #1979 merge: daytime rain is grey, not night.

Day · storm

Dark overcast, rain streaks; white ribbon along the road edge and black terrain underside read as a wet-look artefact.

Day · overcast

Sky stays the same saturated blue as dry: overcast does not grey the sky.

Day · fog

Fog thickens near ground only; blue sky and distant skyline unaffected.

Dusk · dry

Uniform brown/orange wash over terrain and buildings, sky near-black navy.

Dusk · rain

Eye / trackside (dry)

Not captured / uncertain

  • Cut from the matrix: night × overcast/fog/storm/wet, dusk × wet/storm/overcast/fog, dawn entirely; eye/trackside only for dry day and dry night at 3 positions.
  • Cars are visible only at the player position; no grid/race traffic frames. No HUD frames.
  • All frames are TLX on SwiftShader, not a real GPU; bloom/shadow looks may differ on hardware.
  • Defects 3, 4, 5 are visual impressions: no lightState/probe read, and 4 is not confirmed off lat 0. Defect 6 is derived from code, not per-prop measurement.
  • Real-world Sphere dimensions are from memory of public figures, not fetched; High Roller / Bellagio details not checked against sources.
  • Terrain-over-road and sunk water were judged only by eye from 6 positions; the lake looks like a flat opaque slab but transparency may be intended for waterSurface.
